output.description: Runs the table availability rebuild job for a restaurant on a service date, recomputing bookable tables and time slots. Writes a JSON run record (exit code, timestamp) to var/reservations/rebuild_runs, overwriting any prior record for that restaurant and date. Returns the job's exit status and output.
output.declaring_phrase: Writes a JSON run record (exit code, timestamp) to var/reservations/rebuild_runs
